India vs. Sri Lanka Test Series Squads and Player News

Sri Lanka has announced its squad for the first Test against India, which will be played in Galle. Key players Kusal Mendis and Pathum Nissanka will miss the match due to unavailability. Dickwella has been included in the Sri Lankan squad, while Keshara Nuwantha has received his maiden call-up. Meanwhile, reports suggest India may face an injury concern with an all-rounder's fitness in doubt for the series. Ajinkya Rahane is set to make his Test commentary debut during the series.
